transcript:
[turn 1] [user] My friend and I are looking for a place to eat.
[turn 2] [assistant] Please tell me what type of food you are looking for just say Mexican, Chinese or anything else. Also what city would you like me to search int.
[turn 3] [user] My family and I are in San Jose and the perfect place would have pizza and pasta. We don't have a price preference.
[turn 4] [assistant] San Jose has a restaurant called Al Castello Ristorante that is nice.
[turn 5] [user] Is there any other restaurant that you can suggest?
[turn 6] [assistant] There is also a nice restaurant called Angelo's Italian Restaurant in San Jose.
[turn 7] [user] Can I please have the address and contact number?
[turn 8] [assistant] 408-227-5502 is their phone and it is located at 436 Blossom Hill Road.
[turn 9] [user] Is there any other restaurant that you can suggest?
[turn 10] [assistant] There is another nice restaurant called Antonella's Ristorante in San Jose.
[turn 11] [user] That restaurant will work can you please make a reservation for 12:30.
[turn 12] [assistant] I will be booking a table at Antonella's Ristorante in San Jose. The reservation will be set at 12:30 pm for today. And it is for 2 people is this correct.
[turn 13] [user] Yes, thank you that is correct.
[turn 14] [assistant] I have successful made your reservation.
[turn 15] [user] Thank you so much for setting that up.
[turn 16] [assistant] Is there anything else that I can help you with.
[turn 17] [user] That is all thank you so much.
[turn 18] [assistant] Have a good day thank you.
